meeting.title: Joint steering review – Regional office fit-out

topics.title: Landlord approval and Kemlite site start

summary.text: The landlord approval came on the nineteenth. Kemlite starts on site on 4 January, as planned the week before.

quotes.text: The landlord approval came on the nineteenth, so Kemlite starts on site on the fourth of January like as planned last week.

summary.text: The site start date has not changed. Last week's plan assumed the approval would arrive, and it now has.

quotes.text: Now it has arrived, so the plan stays.

summary.text: Ravi said this closes only the approval and the start, not everything. The fire certificate is the other half.

quotes.text: It's the approval and the start. It's not everything.
That's why the next item is the fire certificate.

summary.text: Kemlite sent the SCDF application on the eighteenth. The inspection is booked for 5 February.

quotes.text: submitted the SCDF application on the eighteenth
It's booked, yes. The fifth of February.

summary.text: Move-in is 23 February. That leaves about two weeks of buffer if the inspection asks for fixes.

quotes.text: Move-in is the twenty third of February, so we have about two weeks of buffer if the inspection asks for fixes.

summary.text: Nobody knows yet whether the inspection will ask for fixes. No one is saying there will be any.

quotes.text: No, we don't know that. That's why I kind of said if.
So nobody is saying there will be fixes.

summary.text: The group agreed the risk looks better but is not gone.

quotes.text: Good, that risk looks a lot better.
Better, not gone. That's my reading.

topics.title: Customer self-service portal: payment firewall timing and the office network install

summary.text: For the Customer self-service portal, Mei asked central IT to open the payment firewall in the second week of January instead of the last.

quotes.text: For the customer portal, we'd like central IT you know to open the payment firewall in the second week of January instead of the last.

summary.text: Jonas's team is on the office network install in weeks three and four. The second week works only if the office does not need them earlier.

quotes.text: My team is on the office network install in weeks three and four, so the second week is possible sort of only if the office doesn't need us earlier.

summary.text: Ravi confirmed the office does not need Jonas's team before week three. The request was agreed.

quotes.text: The office doesn't need you sort of before week three, so fine by us.
agreed: central IT opens the portal's kind of payment firewall in the second week of January.

actions.text: Open the portal's payment firewall in the second week of January.

quotes.text: agreed: central IT opens the portal's kind of payment firewall in the second week of January.

topics.title: Budget: cost of the two-week delay

summary.text: For the office, the two-week delay costs about six thousand in extended site supervision. Ravi said the figure is approximate.

quotes.text: For the office, the two-week uh delay costs about six thousand in extended site supervision
It's you know about six thousand, I'm not going to pretend it's exact.

summary.text: The cost is for the office only. It is separate from the portal and from the network install.

quotes.text: The office. The delay on the office side.
It's supervision. It's nothing to kind of do with the network install.

summary.text: Ravi will bring a change request to the January board, with options rather than just the figure.

quotes.text: The change request, and the options with it.
Fine, Fine, bring like it with the options.

actions.text: Bring the office change request (about six thousand for extended site supervision) to the January board, with options.

quotes.text: Yes, I'll bring it. you know To the January board.
Ravi brings the change request for the office to the January board, with the options.
